name: A New Threat
summary: Balir Frosthammer calls for aid as Rockjaw troggs surge through Coldridge Valley and threaten its settlements and camps.

sections.title: Breaching Coldridge Valley
sections.body: Rockjaw troggs claw up from below in growing numbers. Reports reach Anvilmar of troggs swarming the frozen lake and nearby foothills. They disrupt patrols and cut supply routes through the valley pass. For young dwarven warriors and mountaineers, this valley has long been a place to train. Now the threat reaches it.

sections.title: A Camp Overrun
sections.body: A coordinated trogg attack has overrun a dwarven camp west of the valley. The mountaineers retreated and left their posts. Ironforge cannot spare full battle regiments, so Balir Frosthammer calls on newly recruited adventurers to fight through the Rockjaw ranks. The hills must be secured before the creatures reach Anvilmar.

faq.answer: Balir Frosthammer is a seasoned dwarven mountaineer stationed outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He organizes defenses against wild beasts and troggs that threaten local recruits.

faq.q: Why are troggs suddenly in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs are tunneling up from deep fissures across Dun Morogh. Coldridge Valley is among the first populated valleys struck as the creatures break through and overrun surface camps.

faq.q: What camp was overrun by the troggs?
faq.answer: Troggs overwhelmed a dwarven mountaineer camp in the western reaches of Coldridge Valley. The survivors fell back toward Anvilmar.

faq.q: What kind of troggs are threatening the valley?
faq.answer: The attackers belong to the Rockjaw tribe. Standard Rockjaw Troggs and larger, sturdier Burly Rockjaw Troggs lead the advance around the frozen lake and foothills.

faq.q: Is King Magni aware of the trogg problem?
faq.answer: Local guards hope King Magni Bronzebeard and the Ironforge Senate are preparing a wider response. For now, frontier outposts like Coldridge Valley face the surges on their own.

faq.q: What happens after culling these troggs?
faq.answer: Thinning the troggs helps steady Anvilmar's immediate surroundings. Balir and other dwarven officers continue to organize counterattacks to reclaim the western camp and drive the troggs underground.

angles.text: As a young Bronzebeard dwarf leaving Anvilmar, you have a personal duty to drive back the troggs and protect Dun Morogh's sacred grounds and tunnels.
As an Alliance recruit, you help contain the threat from below in Coldridge Valley. That keeps Ironforge's training grounds viable and the southern mountain gate secure.
